memory.query:
SELECT task_id, attempt_id, worker_id, "cluster", count(*) AS samples,
 min(ts) AS first_ts, max(ts) AS last_ts,
 max(memory_peak_mb)/1024.0 AS cumulative_host_peak_gib,
 max(memory_mb)/1024.0 AS sampled_host_peak_gib,
 max(cpu_millicores) AS peak_cpu_millicores,
 max(accelerator_mem_bytes) AS reported_accelerator_mem_bytes
FROM "iris.task"
WHERE task_id='/kaiyuew@stanford.edu/ema-gram-20-single-inner-capture-v5e-8-20261103/0'
 AND attempt_id=0
 AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-03 10:31:00'
 AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-03 10:58:00'
GROUP BY task_id, attempt_id, worker_id, "cluster"
